title: 10 Days & 9 Nights Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu Bali
metaTitle: 10 Days Yoga Retreat In Uluwatu Bali
metaDescription: Join the 10-Day Healing Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu, Bali. Enjoy daily yoga, meditation, healing sessions & Balinese massages in a serene ocean-view setting.
summary: A 10 days & 9 nights yoga retreat in Uluwatu with daily pranayama & meditation, Hatha Vinyasa yoga, healing sessions and 9 complimentary Balinese massages.
intro: Escape to paradise and embark on a 10-Day Healing Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu, Bali, where golden beaches, turquoise waters, and serene ocean breezes create the perfect setting for rejuvenation.
Each day unfolds with energizing yoga classes, pranayama, guided meditation, and soulful Hatha Vinyasa flow sessions designed to cleanse, strengthen, and heal.

Our tranquil retreat center in Uluwatu features private rooms, two beautiful swimming pools, and open garden areas where you can relax, read, or simply soak in the tropical sun. Beyond yoga, enjoy daily healing therapies, sound and reiki sessions, and blissful Balinese massages that melt away stress and tension.

Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced practitioner, our experienced teachers tailor each session to meet your level and intention. You’ll also have free time to explore Uluwatu’s natural wonders — its dramatic sea cliffs, hidden beaches, and vibrant local culture.

items: The Management team holds the right to change the timings of the classes if it is needed.

policies.title: Booking Process
items: In order to book for retreat kindly deposit the Advance booking amount of 150 USD. Balance should be paid on arrival either by card, cash or Online transfer. An official confirmation letter concerning your program will be sent to you shortly after successful advance booking fee.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Advance Booking deposit is non refundable, we accept date rescheduling. If you cancel the course after joining, we accept the cancellation but the course fees will not be refunded with the cancellation.
